name: Workplace: technology
about: An office floor for a technology firm or a global capability centre: open team neighbourhoods, many small rooms for calls and focus, scrum and war rooms, a device lab, a town hall. In three parts: the Workplace: technology typology (on the Workplace one), an office fit-out on an RCC shell, and the BuilderPluss standards with the Indian codes. 2.1.0: its walls, fences, railings, parapets, beams, doors and windows in the versions that say how they sit and meet (R156: justify, corner, priority, align), all as before until one is set.
